description: This file contains implementation of SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) related classes and functions used in Bluetooth audio extensions, specifically for the SDPSocket class and related payload handling.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Represents a payload for SDP descriptors, handling reading and pushing descriptors of various types.

classes.name: PDU
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of Protocol Data Units for Bluetooth SDP communication.

methods.name: Payload::PushDescriptor
methods.description: Pushes an SDP descriptor of a specific type and size into the payload buffer.

methods.name: Payload::ReadDescriptor
methods.description: Reads an SDP descriptor from the payload buffer, extracting its type and size.

methods.name: PDU::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the PDU into a byte stream suitable for transmission.

methods.name: PDU::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a received byte stream into a PDU structure.

methods.name: uint16_t Deserialize(const uint8_t stream[],const uint16_t length)
void PushDescriptor(const elementtype type,const uint32_t size)
uint16_t Serialize(uint8_t stream[],const uint16_t length) const

ctags.name: Deserialize
ctags.pattern: /^    uint16_t PDU::Deserialize(const uint8_t stream[], const uint16_t length)$/

ctags.name: PushDescriptor
ctags.pattern: /^    void Payload::PushDescriptor(const elementtype type, const uint32_t size)$/

ctags.name: ReadDescriptor
ctags.pattern: /^    uint8_t Payload::ReadDescriptor(elementtype& type, uint32_t& size) const$/

ctags.name: Serialize
ctags.pattern: /^    uint16_t PDU::Serialize(uint8_t stream[], const uint16_t length) const$/
